purpose: Maps the 32 UI flows and the 24 global UI cases of baseline 0.9.0 to the automated tests that exercise them locally. Checked by tests/app/test_ui_traceability.py: every referenced file exists and contains the quoted title text. A mapping is evidence that a local automated check exists; it is not live acceptance (fixture tutor, emulated viewports, synthetic courses).

flows.rule: Every flow id UI01–UI32 appears in the title of at least one test under web/e2e/flows, and each flow file runs in two projects: flows-desktop-light (1280×800, Light) and flows-phone-dark (390×844, Dark, touch).

UXG01.how: Every flow runs in a Light and a Dark project; every screen is swept in both themes at five viewports.
tests: renders, reflows and passes automated accessibility

UXG02.how: Theme set by the boot script with the app bundle blocked; storage refused still applies for the session.
tests: UXG02 the chosen theme is applied before the app code runs

UXG03.how: Canvas pixels identical across themes; known fixture colours sampled; no filter/blend/opacity on the source surface.
tests: UI28 Light, Dark and System change only the app's own surfaces
original colours unchanged in this theme

UXG04.how: axe WCAG A/AA rules on every screen and story; tests locate controls by role and accessible name.
tests: every component story renders cleanly in this theme

UXG05.how: Dialog focus in, trapped, Escape, and back to the opener; skip link.
tests: UXG05 dialogs take focus, release it on Escape and return it to the control that opened them

UXG06.how: No horizontal overflow at 360–1440 px; 200% text reflows to the one-pane layout; slide zoom is contained.
tests: UXG06 text enlarged to 200% reflows the app
UI06 the slide is the original

UXG07.how: axe colour-contrast in both themes; token pairs measured by the kit baseline check; chips carry text and an icon.
tests: renders, reflows and passes automated accessibility

UXG08.how: axe target-size (WCAG 2.2); primary controls ≥44 px; typed start/end times instead of dragging.
tests: Primary controls keep a comfortable touch size

UXG09.how: System and in-app reduced motion remove transitions; media never autoplays.
tests: UXG09 reduced motion removes transitions and never starts media by itself

UXG10.how: Named playback controls, transcript with version and timing basis, readable text labeled as a derivative. No captions or descriptions are claimed.
tests: UI07 the recording plays only this slide's segment
Derived text rendition, not the original

UXG11.how: Response frozen before the tutor is called; local save failure and offline retention are stated, not hidden.
tests: when local storage for drafts is unavailable
UI27 when the Brain cannot be reached

UXG12.how: Viewing, asking and finishing a session create no attempt; zero records read as not assessed.
tests: asking for help creates no attempt
UI31 the session summary reports only what happened

UXG13.how: Solutions excluded from search and closed until a recorded reveal; criteria not shown before an attempt.
tests: restricted solutions stay closed until revealed

UXG14.how: Hostile learner/tutor text rendered inertly; text cannot change a capability.
tests: UXG14/UXG20 tutor and learner text is rendered inertly
no active element or script link is produced from tutor text

UXG15.how: Captured / received / native / answer / course-save shown as separate states.

UXG16.how: Double click is one request; same input is one attempt; a bundle is immutable; same id with other bytes is refused.
tests: a double click must not create two requests

UXG17.how: Cancel before start is final without a dispatch; a late result after cancellation is kept as late and not published.
tests: UI25 cancelling a queued request is final only when the Brain confirms

UXG18.how: Regrades and capture corrections are revisions of the same attempt; originals stay byte-identical.
tests: UI21 history shows the exact response
UI17 correcting a mis-captured response links new evidence

UXG19.how: Recorded and occurred times with their basis; an unknown time is shown as unknown.
tests: an unknown time is not invented

UXG21.how: Two devices with diverging positions produce an explicit choice; both drafts kept.
tests: UI26 two devices that stopped in different places

UXG22.how: Learning writer never references the tracking publisher; a source hint registers nothing; views are projections.
tests: A hint only asks the Brain to rescan

UXG23.how: A result is shown only after signature and every file digest verify; a manifest before its payload means wait.
tests: manifest arrived before its payload: keep waiting
returns a result only from a generation whose manifest and signature have arrived

UXG24.how: Not a runtime behaviour: dependencies are the selected maintained libraries, pinned and inventoried; no plugin or hosted service was added.
